name: datacite
label: DataCite Metadata
description: Research data repository standard — used by Zenodo, Figshare, DRYAD, institutional repos

table_notes.dc_creator: Canonical creator/author registry; shared across resources so the same person is not duplicated when they contribute to multiple datasets.
table_notes.dc_resource: Central record for a citable research output identified by a DOI; holds all DataCite mandatory and recommended metadata fields.
table_notes.dc_resource_creator: Many-to-many join between resources and creators, preserving author order (order_num) as required by DataCite citation rules.
table_notes.dc_download: Append-only download event log used for usage statistics reporting to Make Data Count / COUNTER compliance.

dc_creator.name: id
dc_creator.description: Surrogate primary key for this creator record

dc_creator.name: name
dc_creator.description: Full name of the creator (personal: 'Family, Given'; org: full name)

dc_creator.name: name_type
dc_creator.description: Creator type per DataCite schema: 'Personal' or 'Organizational'

dc_creator.name: given_name
dc_creator.description: Given (first) name for personal creators; NULL for organizations

dc_creator.name: family_name
dc_creator.description: Family (last) name for personal creators; NULL for organizations

dc_creator.name: orcid
dc_creator.description: ORCID iD in 0000-0000-0000-0000 format, uniquely identifying the researcher

dc_creator.name: affiliation
dc_creator.description: Array of affiliation objects: [{name, affiliationIdentifier, affiliationIdentifierScheme}]

dc_resource.name: id
dc_resource.description: Internal UUID primary key for this resource record

dc_resource.name: doi
dc_resource.description: Registered DataCite DOI (e.g. 10.5281/zenodo.1234567); globally unique persistent identifier

dc_resource.name: title
dc_resource.description: Array of title objects: [{title, titleType, lang}]; titleType: AlternativeTitle/Subtitle/TranslatedTitle

dc_resource.name: resource_type
dc_resource.description: Free-text resource type as provided by the depositor (e.g. 'CSV Dataset', 'Software package')

dc_resource.name: resource_type_general
dc_resource.description: DataCite controlled vocabulary type: Dataset, Software, Text, Image, Workflow, Other, etc.

dc_resource.name: publisher
dc_resource.description: Entity responsible for making the resource available (e.g. 'Zenodo', 'Dryad')

dc_resource.name: publication_year
dc_resource.description: Year the resource was or will be made publicly available (YYYY)

dc_resource.name: lang_code
dc_resource.description: Primary language of the resource per IETF BCP 47 (e.g. 'en', 'de', 'zh-CN')

dc_resource.name: version
dc_resource.description: Version string of the resource as assigned by the depositor (e.g. '1.0', '2.3.1')

dc_resource.name: rights
dc_resource.description: Array of license/rights objects: [{rights, rightsUri, rightsIdentifier, rightsIdentifierScheme}]

dc_resource.name: description
dc_resource.description: Array of description objects: [{description, descriptionType, lang}]; types: Abstract/Methods/TechnicalInfo/Other

dc_resource.name: subject
dc_resource.description: Array of subject/keyword objects: [{subject, subjectScheme, schemeUri, valueUri, classificationCode}]

dc_resource.name: related_identifiers
dc_resource.description: Array of related resource links: [{relatedIdentifier, relatedIdentifierType, relationType, resourceTypeGeneral}]

dc_resource.name: funding_references
dc_resource.description: Array of funder objects: [{funderName, funderIdentifier, funderIdentifierType, awardNumber, awardUri, awardTitle}]

dc_resource.name: geo_locations
dc_resource.description: Array of spatial coverage objects: [{geoLocationPlace, geoLocationPoint, geoLocationBox, geoLocationPolygon}]

dc_resource.name: file_url
dc_resource.description: Direct download URL for the primary file or archive associated with this resource

dc_resource.name: file_size_bytes
dc_resource.description: Size of the primary file in bytes; used for storage accounting and display

dc_resource.name: created_at
dc_resource.description: Timestamp when this record was first ingested into the local database

dc_resource.name: updated_at
dc_resource.description: Timestamp of the most recent metadata update from the DataCite API

dc_resource_creator.name: id
dc_resource_creator.description: Surrogate primary key for this resource-creator association

dc_resource_creator.name: resource_id
dc_resource_creator.description: References dc_resource.id; the resource this creator contributed to

dc_resource_creator.name: creator_id
dc_resource_creator.description: References dc_creator.id; the contributing creator or author

dc_resource_creator.name: order_num
dc_resource_creator.description: 1-based position of this creator in the author list (citation order)

dc_download.name: id
dc_download.description: Auto-incrementing event ID; BIGSERIAL to handle high-volume repositories

dc_download.name: resource_id
dc_download.description: References dc_resource.id; the resource that was downloaded

dc_download.name: downloaded_at
dc_download.description: UTC timestamp when the download event was recorded

dc_download.name: ip_country
dc_download.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code resolved from the downloader's IP address

short_description: Research data repository standard — used by Zenodo, Figshare, DRYAD, institutional repos
long_description: Research data repository standard — used by Zenodo, Figshare, DRYAD, institutional repos
when_to_use: Use when building applications that need to conform to the DataCite Metadata standard.
